name: agent-pack
description: A programming language to orchestrate agents across every harness.
author: Giuseppe Federico <giuseppefeder@gmail.com>

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/src/config && cp src/config/*.json dist/src/config/ && npm run build:apx
scripts.build:apx:
esbuild src/apx/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --log-level=error --define:import.meta.url=__apxUrl "--banner:js=/*! agent-pack — Copyright (c) 2026 Giuseppe Federico — Apache-2.0 — keep this notice and the NOTICE file */
const __apxUrl = require('url').pathToFileURL(__filename).href;" --outfile=dist/apx-engine.js
